title: Integrate equivariant F4, trace filter, free relations
original_requirement: Integrate equivariant F4, the trace-zero filter and free relations into the incumbent oracle, with separate switches and combinations, and measure the complete pipeline in ecbench.
acceptance_criteria: Register incumbent and candidate with standalone and factorial ablations on the same targets and cost interval.
Check correctness and independent replay; report complete setup and online costs. A reproducible end-to-end gain needs its own complete pipeline evidence.
Preserve the failed equivariant step gate and subgroup-vacuous trace rule. A new presentation or integration gets a distinct prospective protocol.

source_supported_commands.purpose: Existing48-target oraclepanel, stdoutJSONL; L0shared-host timings not isolated evidence.
Existing small steppanel with exact span andpositive controls.

remaining_gaps: The production system has a fixed target and is not Frobenius-symmetric. The proposed equivariant hook applies at zero current nodes; the prior step gate failed on 37 of 37 targets.
The trace filter is vacuous on odd-order subgroup targets. Preserve the requested no-op ablation; do not claim a 50% rejection gain for that target law.

Free relations are already the default for the u64 production example. ecbench registration and complete cold accounting remain separate from this standalone implementation. Use the round-2 tuned-K incumbent.
existing_evidence_notes: The prior equivariant barrel oracle improved at n=11 and 13; ordinary degree-fall transfer to the production system regressed.
The round-1 free-relations pooled ratio 0.957 was qualified by round-2 tuned-K evidence. At the same tuned K, n=41 and n=53 intervals include 1.
The production flag KIC_FREE_RELATIONS=0 restores the previous u64 path; an explicit enable is refused above n=63.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Wire the equivariant F4 pass, the trace-zero prefilter and the free relations into the incumbent oracle and measure them in ecbench.
